messages:
Maya: Quick Q  who wants to do a "Noon Send-it" boulder blitz today? 12:1012:50. Short session, try a couple of V2-V4s and then back to desks. :muscle:

Owen: I'm in if it's short. Can only stay til 12:45.

Tia: Love that name. I'll bring a pad and tape. Also chalk. :chalk:

Ryan: If anyone needs a ride from Mission, I can swing by at 12:05. room for 2 in my car. @lina you up?

Lina: Yep, 12:05 pick-up works. Bringing a spare pair of shoes (women's 8).

Noah: tempted but got a squeeze on my schedule. might drop by for 15 mins after my standup. If I do, i'll just climb 1 or 2 warmups.

Maya: Meeting spot reception 12:05 then walk over. Gym is small so we'll keep it chill.

Owen: Also heads-up GrainyLab has a quick shoe check at 12:15 and a 3-person limit on the slab wall.

Maya: Gym details:
```
GrainyLab Bouldering
Entrance B (alley side)
"Redwood crew" at desk
```

Tia: Cash for shoe rental is $3. They take venmo too.

Ryan: I'll bring a small bandaid kit + a silly pump-up playlist. Suggestion: no dynos unless you really mean it. :sweat_smile:

Maya: Haha agreed. No dyno circus. :raised_hands:

calendar-bot: Event created - "Noon Send-it Boulder Blitz" today 12:10-12:50. Attendees: maya, owen, tia, ryan, lina. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/1792456789

Maya: Cool. If anyone needs to bail last-minute ping here. See ya at reception! :wave:
